title: "Hide results on init" example breaks URL sync

comments.body:
Thanks @bobylito for this solution!

It's not ideal as it triggers a search every time the page loads, even if the user is not searching (I'm trying to limit the number of requests to Algolia to stay in our quota).
In my case, the items on the page are already rendered server-side, so I have a kind of blink during the time of the request (you notice it even if it's only a few dozen ms).

Do you see another option?
Not for now. I'll be looking for a fix :/
This bug has its roots in the attempt to fix #2105 Revisiting the fix to provide a less invasive one.
